why: Each line is shown twice, then it turns clockwise by the same amount: / , / , then upright | , | . Turning once more by the same amount gives a line leaning the other way (\) as much as the first line leaned, which is option 2. Option 1 leans too little and option 4 goes back to the start.
trick: Look for figures that repeat in pairs; then find the change between the pairs.
